name: Disneyland Tropical Hideaway Steamed Chicken/Pork Bao Bun vs. Pineapple DOLE Whip
whyItWorks: Fluffy, cloud-like steamed white-flour bao buns filled with savory chicken or char siu pork (skipping the spicy lime pork bao) are 100% dairy-free, non-fried, and gentle on the stomach; classic Pineapple or Mango DOLE Whip is also 100% dairy-free and lactose-free!
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Teriyaki/Spiced Vegetable-Free Chicken or Char Siu Bao Bun (avoid the Spicy Lime Pork Bao), and for dessert choose Dairy-Free Pineapple, Mango, or Strawberry DOLE Whip (avoid Lemon/Orange citrus swirls).
watchOuts: Avoid the Spicy Lime Pork Bao and Lemon DOLE Whip flavor (citrus triggers)
